items.name: Polynomial.leadingCoeff_taylor
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) : ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).leadingCoeff = f.leadingCoeff

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_taylor_natDegree
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) : ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff f.natDegree = f.leadingCoeff

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_coeff_zero
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) : ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff 0 = Polynomial.eval r f

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_coeff
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) : ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff n = Polynomial.eval r ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) f)

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_coeff_one
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) : ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff 1 = Polynomial.eval r (Polynomial.derivative f)
